digest.component_or_area: Outbound parent reconciliation (CREATE emit and ACLI attach fallback)
propositions: CREATE emit drops a non-epic bound parent without recording to bridge_alerts, leaving only a debug log line
ACLI attach fallback swallows HTTP 400 parent rejection with a WARNING log but never calls record_parent_divergence
An unbound parent must remain silent during CREATE because it converges on a later pass and alerting would be churn
The suppressed_out parameter must thread through map_local_to_jira_fields, OutboundMapper.map_local_to_remote, and _compute_outbound_create_mutation to reach the existing dropped_field_sink channel
ACLI 400 rejection must record as outbound-parent-rejected divergence using the same record_parent_divergence helper dispatch_one uses
Documentation must clarify that the epic-only parent guard applies universally: Cloud rejects it with HTTP 400, Data Center accepts and silently ignores it
